## Complete implementation delivered — all artifacts produced and validated

**Files:** `analysis.py` (runs with no args, deterministic seed=42) → `results/state_estimates.csv`, `results/filter_diagnostics.csv`, `results/summary.json`, `results/overview.png`, `results/conclusion.txt` (+ `results/audit_extra.csv` per-step outlier/bias/mode audit).

**Implementation as approved:** N=1000 bootstrap PF; 6-state [px,py,vx,vy,bias_r,bias_b] + 2-mode Markov-switched CV (P=[0.94,0.06]/[0.03,0.97], σ_a=[0.008,0.30]); Student-t(ν=4) per-channel likelihood — no deletion/replacement of observations; missing channels skipped; bearing innovations wrapped to (−π,π]; systematic resampling at ESS<N/2. Output CSVs marginalize mode+bias; covariances are total ensemble covariance (E[P_mode]+between-mode spread). Scales anchored at robust 2nd-difference noise floor (×3/×6 temper) with ONE bounded NIS check: (0.097, 0.044)→mean NIS 0.54→one adjustment→(s_r=0.0581, s_b=0.0263)→mean NIS 1.71.

**(i) Final summary.json values (required keys):** pos_rmse 0.1427 (proxy), vel_rmse 0.0936 (proxy), mean_nees **1.714** (in your 1–2 band), median_nees 0.060, ess_min 1.35, ess_mean 405.7, resampling_count 54, weight_degeneracy_detected 1, used_log_weights 1, angle_wrapping_detected 1, angle_wrap_event_count **1** (gap-aware, t=5→6 +π crossing; post-gap diffs excluded). Extras: obs_domain_pos_residual_rms_robust **0.0694**, median 0.0538; NIS lag-1 autocorr +0.05 (range) / +0.42 (bearing); bias/ maneuver/outlier fields below.

**(ii) ESS/resampling trend:** mean ESS 41% of N → N kept at 1000 (rule: bump only if mean ESS<25%N; documented in summary). 54 resampling events, clustered exactly at outlier bursts (t=17,49,72,79) and the closest-approach segment (t=31–42), as physically expected. ESS<5% of N (transient degeneracy, flagged honestly) at t=17,32,34,37–39,41,49,50,72,73,75,76,80,82–84 — min 1.35 at t=73 (joint gross-error burst); cloud recovers via maneuver-mode diffusion.

**(iii) Innovation/NIS behaviour:** median NIS 0.06 / p90 ~0.9 (calm steps slightly over-dispersed — conservative), mean dominated by genuine model-strain steps t=36 (CPA, NIS≈27) and outliers t=49/72/79 (≈9–15). Range innovations essentially white (lag-1 +0.05); bearing +0.42 reflects correlated residuals around CPA — reported, not hidden. Outlier-flagged (|res|>4×scale, kept+down-weighted): t=17,36,37,41,49,72,73,74,75,79,80; both channels jointly at t=79.

**(iv) Maneuvers & bias:** maneuver intervals (5-pt MA of P(maneuver)>0.10 vs prior 0.06, max 0.25): **t=39..43** (coincides with closest-approach/speed-change segment — genuine) and **t=78..82** (adjacent to the t=79 gross-error burst — conclusion explicitly labels this "model strain," not a proven turn). Bias (partially identifiable, regularized — stated in conclusion): range final −0.0094 (total drift 0.036), bearing final +0.027 rad (total drift 0.035 rad).

**(v) Runtime:** total wall-clock ≈1.6 s per full run (load + calibration probe + final 1000×95 filter + outputs); core filter ≈0.08 s. Determinism verified by double-run: all CSVs byte-identical; only `runtime_seconds` differs in summary.json.

**Validation evidence:** exact required CSV column names/order, 95 rows each, every numeric field finite, covariances >0; all 11 required summary keys present and finite; PNG parses (1000×620, 13k non-white pixels) via matplotlib-primary/numpy-fallback path (matplotlib absent in sandbox — fallback exercised; matplotlib branch would run in the spec'd runtime); bearing_residual_mean/std = 0.0 exactly at t=55..63 with the "no angular data ≠ perfect residual" caveat plus range-gap t=22..31 documented in conclusion.txt; triangulated-pseudo-measurement cross-check median 0.054 confirms trajectory coherence; trajectory runs (−2.73, 0.21)→(3.31, 1.98), matching raw triangulation.

**Limitations:** RMSE/NEES remain truth-free proxies (definitions embedded in summary.json + conclusion.txt); NIS mean is sensitive to the 3–4 genuine model-strain steps; bearing innovation autocorrelation +0.42 indicates mild dynamic under-modelling at CPA; bias/mode attribution near t=72–82 is only weakly separable — both audit files expose per-step numbers.
